audience: insurance agency staff and agents who manage clients, groups and policies in AgencyBloc

useCases.title: Find an individual or group and see their policies
useCases.text: The AI searches individuals and groups by the filters you give, then opens one record with its addresses, policies and custom fields. You get the whole picture in one answer.

useCases.title: Search policies by carrier, type or date
useCases.text: The AI searches policies by number, coverage type, carrier, holder, servicing agent, application date or last update, and opens one for premium, dates and coverages.

useCases.title: List open activities and read notes on a record
useCases.text: The AI lists the activities (tasks, calls, renewals) logged on a group, individual, agent, carrier or lead, and the notes on an agent, group, individual or policy.

useCases.title: Create or update an individual or a policy
useCases.text: The AI creates or updates client and policy records. A policy's carrier product requires the carrier name; updates first check for at most one coverage. Unknown product names create carrier products. Search first to avoid duplicates.

useCases.title: Log an activity or add a note to a record
useCases.text: The AI logs an activity such as a call, task or renewal reminder, or adds a note to an agent, group, individual or policy. Notes are permanent and cannot be edited or deleted.

useCases.title: Create or update a group
useCases.text: The AI creates a group (an employer or business account) or changes the fields of an existing group, including its name. Search first to avoid duplicates.
